page.layout: One column of text. Above it, a decorative woodcut border (no text) and a centred dedication title in several lines. Below the title, a woodcut initial I at the left, with the text wrapping around it. Under the last line: a signature at the left and a catchword at the right.

page.notes: Woodcut initial I, with the word "Nter" printed beside it: read as "INter". The title block is one dedication heading; its lines are italic or roman as printed. "cdimus" is not clear and may be a printing error for "edimus". The signature at the foot is read as "g ii" and is uncertain. The word after "suspiriis" may be "feriis" in the print; read as "seriis". No page number or running head is printed. Small ink marks in the right margin are not text and are left out.
